title: BUGA-SHYDYRAA
subtitle: A traditional Tuvan board game
draft: * The Tuvan translation is a draft and needs a native speaker's review.
win_bulls: Bulls win — fewer than 9 boys remain.
win_boys: Boys win — both bulls are trapped.
draw_repeat: Draw — the position has occurred three times.
hint_place: Select an empty node to place a boy from your reserve.
hint_move: Select a piece, then a highlighted node.
hint_over: Start a new game to play again.
web_only: Online play is available in the web version.
leave_hint: Leaving ends the game for both players.
intro: Bulls capture by jumping. Boys win by trapping both bulls.
register_hint: Use at least 10 characters for registration. Guests only need a nickname.
rule_1: 1. Bulls move first. The board starts with 2 bulls and 8 boys; 16 more boys are in reserve.
rule_2: 2. A bull moves along a line to an adjacent empty node or jumps over one boy to capture it. Captures are optional; there are no multiple jumps.
rule_3: 3. Boys place one piece per turn until the reserve is empty. They then move along lines to adjacent empty nodes, without capturing.
rule_4: 4. Boys must trap both bulls. Bulls win when fewer than 9 boys remain, counting the reserve.
rule_5: 5. Draw: the third occurrence of a position with the same turn and reserve, or 60 plies without a capture. Placements count as plies too.
rule_variant: The victory threshold and draw conditions are this app's rule variant.
